runs.note: Answer 10: she can help them vote
turns: How do I get an absentee ballot in here? I ain't missed an election since 1964.
runs.reply: Sixtieth year? That is quite a record, and voting is mighty important. In North Carolina, staff where you live are not allowed to help with an absentee ballot, but you can get one through a close relative or by calling your county board of elections directly, and they can send out a team to help you right here.
